newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 1997 WORK PENSION FEE RISES TO 21.2 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 1997 WORK PENSION FEE RISES TO 21.2 PCT.

text.p: Work pension contributions will be raised to 21.2 percent of wages next year from 21.1 percent this year, the ministry of social and health affairs (STM) said in a statement on Monday.
Employees will pay 4.5 percent, up from 4.3 percent this year, and employers on average 16.7 percent, down from 16.8 percent, STM said.
The work pension funding rate (TEL laskuperustekorko) will be cut in 1997 to 5.5 percent from 6.0 percent, it said.
